top_signals.title: Silver Lake to merge two software firms in $11.6 billion bet on AI
top_signals.summary: French firms Cegid, which sells business management software, and Silae, a payroll and HR platform, are set to combine.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin miners are missing the crypto rally as exchanges, stablecoins surge
top_signals.summary: Among tracked companies, only one bitcoin mining company has outperformed the cryptocurrency: Canaan (ticker CAN).
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: TRM Labs doubles valuation to $2B in Series C expansion
top_signals.summary: The blockchain intelligence firm said its annual recurring revenue has quadrupled over the past three years as it expands its AI-powered investigations business.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: South Korea to skip Sado mine memorial service for third year
top_signals.summary: It will be the third consecutive year of South Korea's absence from the memorial service, which honors workers at the now-defunct mines.
